lines: The Werewolf roared into the night sky and swung his sharp claws down.
But we weren't giving in either.
Even after being cut by the two of them, the Werewolf showed no signs of fatigue and swung his sharp claws in anger.
No way... How can he be so tough!?
If this keeps up, we're going to be the ones getting exhausted.
No wonder he had been boasting about taking us on five against one. Even facing Shishigami and Hebiko at the same time, his prowess was unfaltering.
(The other guys seem to be human... But why is there a Werewolf among normal gangsters!?)
What the hell is that guy!? Even Shishigami and Hebiko together aren't able to give him a single scratch.
『Werewolvesーalso known as lycanthropes. A type of wolf from the Devildom that can turn into a human.
They possess robust and flexible bodies, great power, regenerative abilities to immediately heal lacerations, and sharp claws and fangs that can even tear through steel.
The golden gleam of their eyes dulls the mind and paralyzes any ordinary person, rendering them unable to move.
If you are unfortunate enough to encounter one, avoid combat at all costs and retreat immediately.』
A-And those two somehow seem to be moving slower than usual...
That must have been because of the power of the Werewolf's golden beast eye. I wasn't getting paralyzed by it either, but my body did have some kind of tingling sensation.
But it ends here. Shikanosuke, it's your turn.
When I gave the signal, Hebiko and Shishigami nodded at each other, then leaped towards the Werewolf's face.
Ace Katana Style: Blade Dance of Divinity!!
And when the Werewolf stopped moving for an instantー
Electric Jutsu Ultimate Skill! Bambi-no Spark!!!
The electric energy discharged by Shikanosuke took the form of two fawns that rushed the Werewolf.
The swords of Shishigami and Hebiko pierced the Werewolf as he struggled to escape the heat.
D-Did we do it!? Did we kill him!?
We didn't kill him. Fuma told us not to kill him because it would make everything even more complicated.
More importantly, Shikanosuke-chan's attack earlier! That was an amazing super-skill!!
Did you awaken to a new ability?
Hehe... would be nice if that was the case. It's all thanks to Fuma.
Yeah, I had a talk with the maintenance department and had them make a battery for Shikanosuke.
So it's just temporarily boosting my power. Unfortunately, it's not my own strength.
Oh, but it's you who's controlling that energy, isn't it? Then it's a new ability!
Behind Shikanosuke, who didn't look completely unhappy, the Werewolf's giant body wriggled.
This guy... is still able to move!?
『GRRRRGH!!! YOU TAImaNIN brATS!!! Don't UNDerESTImate ME!!!』
Even though his wounds were not fatal, they still should have been extremely painful if he moved. Despite that, the Werewolf struggled in an attempt to attack us again.
Do you want to die!? Don't struggle.
When the Werewolf howled, his wounds suddenly began to close and, if anything, his muscles even seemed to be bulging.
The clouds cleared and moonlight illuminated the city. I remembered one of the pieces about Werewolves that I had read in the library of Gosha.
Never fight a Werewolf, especially not on a night of the full moon. No matter how much of a veteran Taimanin you are.
The Werewolf's wounds closed before our eyes, and his burnt coat regrew, glossy and new.
And then he swung his powerful arm and sent Shishigami and Hebiko flying.
Aieeee!? I-I'm already out of powerrrrrr!?
Owowow... What is this!? It might be looking bad!?
His power is on a completely different level from before...! Fuma, give me permission to use my Divine Jutsu!!
No, you can't!!! Not right in the middle of the city!!!
That was Shishigami's way-too-powerful Ninja Art. As much as I would've liked to let her use it, it was the absolute last resort.
『WHat's WRoooNG?!!! I'm goNNA DEVour YOu aLL!!!』
Meanwhile, the eyes of the Werewolf, who was overflowing with power, gleamed at the turning of the tables.
Me too... His golden beast eyes must have gotten more powerful as well.
Hooray! It's a blessing from the heavens!!
When had she gotten behind him?
Chevalier held a delicate bottle in her hand and sprinkled a mysterious liquid on the Werewolf's tail.
『!? WhAT!? WHat are YOu doING!?! GRRrgghh...』
And then smoke rose from the Werewolf's tail, eventually enveloping him completelyー
By the time the smoke had cleared, the Werewolf had completely turned back into a human.
That was a potion that absorbs any supernatural power. It looks like the experiment was a success.
You're fortunate that you didn't turn into some kind of weird creature.
The Werewolf kept cursing, but had no strength left to fight.
Then Hebiko quickly restrained him with her octopus legs. The other gangsters also lost the will to fight, put down their guns, and raised their hands.
We were inside the house of Chevalier the alchemist, together with the still tied-up leader.
Well then, let me ask you again. Why did you suddenly attack this place? And what did you mean by "the guys who got your old man"?
I... we are members of an old underground organization that has been doing business in Tokyo Kingdom for a long time.
That being said, there are only about 10 members in total, a small-time gang you might say.
Our old man was the founding boss of this organization and we all owe him a lotー
According to what the leader told usー
They were a local, small-time group of gangsters, a family-like organization united under a boss they called "old man."
Most of the members were abandoned or living on the street as children and had been taken in by their old man.
The Werewolf himself had been picked up as a baby from a dumpster by the old man, who had come to Yomihara for a job. He was a true "stray dog."
They had loved their old man as if he were their real father and had grown up together like brothers.
When Tokyo Kingdom turned into a lawless city, the organization had been on the brink of crisis many times but had barely managed to scrape along.
And after Nomad reached their shores, they became an affiliate of Dragon Gate and had somehow found a way to survive.
But thenーOur old man went to a Dragon Gate meeting, and to our shock, he came back as a Zombie!
Even small-time gangsters have their pride, so we were desperate to find the guys who did that to him.
And then we got a tip.
A tip that the alchemist living here had made a gas that turns people into Zombies and had her Taimanin minions spread it throughout the city.
ーThat sounded familiar. We reflexively looked at each other.
(Yeah, the "CD Virus." Dragon Gate also fits the story. He must've gotten caught up in it back then.)
The dreaded CD Virus that turns people into Zombies.
Gaiza had stolen it from the UFS and spread it around Dragon Gate establishments in order to take over their territory.
(But how did this all turn into our, and this alchemist's, fault?)
With our old man having lost his mind, we had no choice but to...
None of us could kill our old man. But because he lost his mind and indiscriminately attacks anyone, we still keep him tied up and locked in the basement.
He'd be killed if someone found him. His body is rotting too, so we're not sure how long he'll...
The gangsters lowered their heads in unison. And then...
If we're talking about medicine to turn a Zombie back into a human, I have some.
I was flooded with requests during that Zombie debacle, you know. I made a lot, so there's still some left over.
Chevalier took a small bottle from a shelf and showed it to us.
Don't be fooled! She's the one who created the Zombie gas in the first place!
Ah, about that. Allow me to explain.
I explained everything I knew about the "CD Virus."
Starting from my connection to Gaiza, to our part-time job that had been connected to the transport of the CD gas, absolutely everything.
ーAnd so we are after Nisha Gaiza, the leader behind this plot.
After hearing the whole story, the gangsters turned towards us with meek faces.
We won't forgive that Gaiza guy!!
Involving normal people, what a disgrace to gangsters!
Must be hard for you to be betrayed by one of your own people. Sorry for suspecting you.
(G-Good thing they're eager to sympathize ... Sometimes just explaining everything honestly also seems to work as a strategy...)
I'm glad you were able to see our side.
It was looking pretty questionable at one point!
The wounds of Shishigami and Hebiko also seemed to have been completely healed by Chevalier's medicine.
Looks like we got the misunderstanding cleared up.
Yeah, we're going to try giving this medicine to our old man. By the way, you there, the octopus...
It's my first time meeting a fellow shapeshifter, or... someone as beautiful as you.
Ouch!! Why did you hit me, Hebiko?!
So, well, if you don't mind... being my... together with me...
Holy cow, this isn't the time for that! Come on, let's go home already and have the old man drink the medicine!!
Sorry about that, he's not a bad guy but always a bit quick to fall in love.
Yeah, yeah, turning into a wolf won't change anything. So long, Miss Alchemist.
The Werewolf was dragged away by the gangsters, howling begrudgingly as they left.
Thank you for driving away those bandits, all you cute Taimanin.
So, what's the real issue at hand? You didn't come all the way here for no reason, surely.
Yeah, we came here because we heard that you're a knowledgeable alchemist.
We are Taimanin from Gosha. It's a long story, but I want to know more about the "power of demons." Do you have a book or something like that you'd sell to me?
Be a bit more specific. Various things could be called the power of demons. For example, the power to create fire or wind, or the power to open a gate to another world.
There's also the power of regeneration to heal physical wounds. Like that Werewolf from earlier.
I want to know more about the power of regeneration, like that Werewolf used!!!
Right then, the power of regeneration.
Do you have anything in mind?
Yes. But Chevalier's archives are extensive.
Come back again later. In the meantime, Chevalier will find some books for you.
But temper your expectations. There are not many demons who write down every little thing the way you humans do.
Yes, please help me if you can.
These books will not be sold for money. You understand, don't you?
She must have wanted me to take on some kind of request, like Madam, the information broker, always did. That was more convenient for me as well.
And on the way home we stopped at the market again.
Hey, what's wrong? You look like you've seen a Zombie.
Upon seeing my face at the store again, Zocht went pale.
That's right. We should be dead by now after being attacked by those gangsters, right?
N-Not sure what you're talking about...
Seeing Shishigami stand behind me silently, Zocht visibly broke out in a cold sweat and backed away.
Come now, don't get so tense.
Thanks to you, we were able to meet the alchemist. And you got your payday selling that information to the gangsters.
...Heh, heheh, you seem to be quite understanding, kid.
It's a win-win situation. And I mean, it's not like I'm suspecting you of trying to get rid of us at the same time, even though you loathe us so much.
That's how it is. I'll be counting on you if something else comes up.
And like that, I got my hands on another source of information, and we left Tokyo Kingdom.
